chunks: Moses asked: 'O Sameri, what was the matter?'

key_terms.سَامِرِيُ: Sameri (the specific individual responsible for the golden calf)

ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Musa ask Samiri about the golden calf?
ai.summary: In this verse, Prophet Musa (peace be upon him) confronts al-Samiri, asking 'What was your affair?' to uncover the root of his deviation during the Israelites' absence. Shia exegetes often highlight this moment as a critical juncture where Musa seeks to understand whether Samiri acted out of personal whim or divine inspiration, emphasizing the distinction between true guidance and fabricated idolatry.
